nodes.name: Error Trigger
nodes.notes: Runs when YouTube social posting fails (Facebook/IG/TikTok/Shorts).

parameters.subject: ={{ 'n8n error: ' + ($json.workflow?.name || 'workflow') }}
parameters.text: ={{ (() => { const wf = $json.workflow || {}; const ex = $json.execution || {}; const id = String(ex.id || ''); const wfid = String(wf.id || ''); const last = String(ex.lastNodeExecuted || ''); const msg = String(ex.error?.message || $json.error?.message || JSON.stringify($json, null, 2)); const url = (wfid && id) ? ('https://n8n.homelab.lan/workflow/' + wfid + '/executions/' + id) : 'https://n8n.homelab.lan/'; return ['n8n workflow failed.', '', 'Workflow: ' + (wf.name || ''), 'Execution: ' + id, 'Last node: ' + last, 'Open: ' + url, '', 'Error:', msg].join('\n'); })() }}
